marc:datafield.marc:subfield: Pop culture: a view from the paparazzi

"One of the most popular comic actors of his time, Will Ferrell is the ultimate entertainer. For years his mastery of improvisation and impersonation earned him rave reviews on the long-running sketch comedy program 'Saturday Night Live'. There, his uncanny impressions and parodies of a wide range of people in the public eye - including politicians, game show hosts, and singers -- made him the number one SNL cast member. After a long run with the show, Will left 'Saturday Night Live', and brought his unique brand of comedy to film, working both as a writer and actor. His approach to making people laugh is to provide them with an endless stream of outrageous characters and moments. Among the many successes of Will's movie career are the smash hit comedies 'Elf', 'Andchorman : the Legend of Ron Burgundy', 'Talladega Nights : the Ballad of Ricky Bobby', and 'Blades of Glory'. "- back cover
